commit_message: Add ADR0155 managed local runtime core
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR0155 managed Local AI
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0155 in staged product changes, beginning with the application-layer managed llama.cpp runtime, pinned provenance, GGUF registration, Windows/WSL execution identities, loopback lifecycle, and deterministic verification. Follow-up requests on this same Draft PR integrate the managed backend with AI Studio and benchmark evidence.
